title: MIT6.5940: TinyML and Efficient Deep Learning Computing

unit.title: Measurement-First Weight Quantization
unit.scope: One bounded introductory engineering study unit; not a reconstruction of an MIT lecture or assignment.
prerequisites: Deep-learning basics, including weights and linear layers
Computer-architecture basics, including numeric representation and memory cost
learning_objectives: Turn an efficiency claim into an explicit, testable numerical contract.
Implement deterministic symmetric per-tensor weight quantization for a small linear operator.
Build tests that cover ordinary inputs, boundaries, malformed inputs, and reproducibility.
Measure error, logical storage, and runtime without assuming that reduced precision guarantees a speedup.
Document interfaces, assumptions, tradeoffs, and evidence as an engineer would for a maintainable component.
